# Test fixtures

- `survey_literature_curated.jsonl` — Curated single-turn prompts used for **regression tests**; labels mirror public taxonomy language from **survey literature** on jailbreak / indirect-injection methods, alongside benign enterprise-style controls. It is not an exhaustive benchmark.

- `stress_ood.jsonl`, `stress_agentic_min.json` — Additional **synthetic** stress checks for multi-turn and OOD phrasing.
